name: Eyeless Jack
description: Eyeless Jack is a fictional character from internet creepypasta fiction, depicted as a figure in a black hoodie and blue mask with empty, black-fluid-leaking eye sockets who breaks into homes to harvest and eat human organs — particularly kidneys.
full_description: Eyeless Jack is a fictional horror character that emerged from internet creepypasta culture, first appearing in 2012. He is typically depicted as a humanoid entity wearing a black hoodie and a blue mask, with empty eye sockets leaking black fluid, who stalks victims at night, breaks into their homes, and surgically removes and consumes their internal organs — most characteristically their kidneys. The character was created by a user on the Creepypasta Wiki (username Azelf5000) and published on February 25, 2012. A reference image associated with the character was originally posted on 4chan on June 7, 2010, by a user named Arnon as part of a thread about disturbing imagery from video games. Eyeless Jack became part of the informal 'creepypasta canon' of recurring internet horror characters, alongside Slender Man, Jeff the Killer, and others. Fan-created origin stories — most notably one by Kiki-Hyuga — elaborated the character's backstory significantly beyond the original story. The character has no basis in real events or sightings.
origin: As an internet-based fictional character, Eyeless Jack has no geographic distribution in the traditional sense. The character circulates globally through English-language and translated creepypasta communities.
